messages:
Rae (Design): Quick note from testing on a Samsung Fold: our compact table toolbar collapses but the touch targets get cramped when folded. Hitting the filter chip opens the wrong menu sometimes.
Omar (Product): Which breakpoint did you hit? Is the toolbar moving to two rows?
Rae (Design): It switches to a stacked layout at <=420px but on the folded inner display the width is ~280px and the toolbar becomes two cramped rows. See screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/fold-toolbar.png
Kira (Frontend): Reproduced in a real foldable emulator. The second row pushes the header sticky up and causes a 1px gap flash on scroll. Looks like our sticky header calculation uses offsetHeight before rendering the overflow row.
Samir (Mobile): On Android fold emulator the input region overlaps the menu trigger because of different safe-area insets. On iOS we don't get foldables but small phones show similar behavior.
Rae (Design): UX suggestion: change collapse behavior for ultra-narrow widths: move secondary actions into a compact overflow menu and keep a single-row primary toolbar with icons only. That preserves header height.
Kira (Frontend): Technically easiest: detect available toolbar width at render and switch to `overflowToMenu=true` when width < 320px. Add transition to avoid layout jank: set toolbar container height explicitly during swap.
Samir (Mobile): Also add `touch-action: manipulation` on toolbar buttons to avoid double-tap delay and ensure `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch` if we allow horizontal scrolling.
Omar (Product): Sounds good. What about discoverability? Icons-only might hide some actions.
Rae (Design): Keep a persistent primary CTA as label+icon, convert others to icons or overflow. Provide short tooltip on long-press and an onboarding dot the first time someone hits the folded layout.
Kira (Frontend): Accessibility items: overflow trigger needs `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded`, menu items need role="menuitem" and keyboard access. Also ensure we don't trap focus when navigation toggles.
Rae (Design): Copy tweak: label the overflow trigger "More actions" (not "More") per previous feedback. Also ensure the tooltip uses plain language.
Omar (Product): Next steps: Kira to prototype the width-detection fallback and explicit height transition. Samir to test on foldable hardware tomorrow. Rae will add a compact-toolbar mock. I'll create ticket RDC-1302 and link this thread.
UX-Bot: Automated note: created RDC-1302 "Compact toolbar - foldable & ultra-narrow layout behavior" and attached device repro notes.
Kira (Frontend): Will push a draft branch later today and link the PR. :shipit:
